data.title: Lemon Volcano Fizz
data.description: Discover the hidden magic of kitchen chemistry by mixing lemon juice and baking soda to create a fizzy eruption!

experiment.name: Lemon Volcano Eruption
experiment.realWorldConnection: This is very similar to how baking powder helps cakes and breads rise when you bake them in the oven!

substances.name: Lemon Juice
substances.safetyInfo: Avoid contact with eyes; wash hands after.
substances.imagePrompt: fresh yellow lemon juice in a small glass beaker

substances.name: Baking Soda
substances.safetyInfo: Do not taste or inhale powder.
substances.imagePrompt: white baking soda powder in a small dish

reaction.particleDescription: When the lemon juice touches the baking soda, their particles crash together and trade pieces, instantly building tiny new gas bubbles that escape into the air!

challenges.instruction: What do you think will happen when we pour lemon juice onto the baking soda?
challenges.targetAnswer: Bubbles will form and it will fizz
challenges.hint: Think about what happens when an acid meets a powder with trapped air inside.
challenges.narration: Get ready to observe closely and unlock the secrets of chemical change!

options.text: Bubbles will form and it will fizz
The liquid will turn completely solid
The mixture will turn bright blue

challenges.instruction: Do you predict that this reaction will create a brand new gas?
challenges.targetAnswer: Yes, carbon dioxide gas will be created
challenges.hint: Watch the bubbles as they rise up and escape into the air.
challenges.narration: Let us test our ideas about what happens to the ingredients during mixing!

options.text: Yes, carbon dioxide gas will be created
No, it will only create water vapor
No, gases can never be made from liquids and solids
Yes, oxygen gas will make a bright flame

challenges.instruction: What kind of change do you predict this fizzing eruption will be?
challenges.targetAnswer: A chemical change because new substances are formed
challenges.hint: Ask yourself if you can easily turn the foam back into original lemon juice and baking soda.
challenges.narration: Fantastic prediction work! Science is all about testing our thoughts.

options.text: A chemical change because new substances are formed
A physical change because the color stays similar
